title: The hospice-surge agencies in the federal quality files
question: How do the hospices in the hospice-surge case score on the federal Hospice Care Index and family survey, and who shares their address?
finding: 4 of the case's hospices are in the November 2026 federal file. 1 score below the California middle Hospice Care Index of 9.0 (out of 10); 0 have no index published. Home Connect Hospice, LLC: index 5.0 (3.6% of California hospices score as low or lower), Medicare spending per patient $25,014 (national percentile 80); Grace and Glory Hospice, Inc: index 9.0 (75.6% of California hospices score as low or lower), Medicare spending per patient $39,935 (national percentile 98); Best Hospice Provider, INC.: index 9.0 (75.6% of California hospices score as low or lower), Medicare spending per patient $22,523 (national percentile 70); Physicians Hospice Group: index 10.0 (100.0% of California hospices score as low or lower), Medicare spending per patient $28,599 (national percentile 89). The federal quality file lists Attaie Healthcare Inc and A Plus Prime Care Hospice Inc under trade names; the federal enrolment file carries their registered names and the same certification numbers.
how: Hospice general information, provider data (measure H_012_00, the Hospice Care Index overall score, 0 to 10, built from ten claims indicators for 2024-2025 such as early and late live discharges, gaps in nursing visits, spending per patient and visits near death) and the family survey summary star, for California hospices. Case hospices are found by name. Same address compares the street line without the suite number, against Bay Area hospices and home-health agencies.
limits: The index and survey need enough patients; a new agency often has none published. A low index is a claims pattern, not proof of improper billing: an agency serving people with dementia or other long illnesses has longer stays and more live discharges. Agencies in one office building share a street line without any other tie.

sources.t: CMS Provider Data Catalog: hospice general information, hospice provider data (Hospice Care Index) and hospice family survey (CAHPS), November 2026
